legalBoundaryDisclaimer.domesticShortageVsVisaGrant: Crucial Legal Distinction: Domestic occupational shortage indicates employer recruitment difficulty within Australia, but does NOT grant automatic visa rights to foreign candidates. Overseas applicants must separately qualify under Home Affairs migration points and pass TRA/ACS skills assessments.

evidence.claim: 澳大利亚计算机协会 (ACS) 规定：非对口专科需通过 RPL 认定并扣除 5~6 年全职工作经验方可换取技术评估。
quotes: Non-ICT Diploma qualifications require 6 years of full-time professional ICT work experience plus an RPL project report.
Work experience must be deemed skilled and post-qualification unless RPL guidelines apply.

evidence.claim: JSA 明确区分：国内劳动力紧缺统计用于指导本土职业教育与雇主招聘，不等同于独立技术移民直接获批。
quotes: Domestic shortages identify employer hiring difficulty in Australia, separate from Department of Home Affairs migration visa criteria.
